name: naru
description: A WebGPU-native engine for massive CAD and BIM.

scripts.check: pnpm run adr:check && pnpm run fixtures:check && pnpm run fixtures:external:check && pnpm run occt:diagnostics:check && pnpm run phase1:evidence:check && pnpm run ifc:federation:check && pnpm run ifc:browser:check && pnpm run ifc:first-frame:check && pnpm run browser:evidence:check && pnpm run safari:compatibility:check && pnpm run precision:check && pnpm run benchmark:industrial:check && pnpm run benchmark:heterogeneous:check && pnpm run benchmark:repeatability:check && pnpm run benchmark:gpu-timing:check && pnpm run benchmark:gpu-timing:integrated:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.phase1:compile:evidence: pnpm --filter @naru3d/compiler... run build && node packages/compiler/dist/evidence-cli.js artifacts/occt/repeated-fasteners.scene.json artifacts/phase1/repeated-fasteners
scripts.precision:evidence: pnpm --filter @naru3d/compiler... run build && pnpm --filter @naru3d/webgpu-spike... run build && node scripts/record-coordinate-precision-evidence.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @naru3d/scene-ir run build && pnpm --filter @naru3d/runtime-webgpu run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
scripts.benchmark:repeatability: node scripts/record-industrial-benchmark.mjs --output artifacts/benchmarks/heterogeneous-repeatability --scale target --profile heterogeneous --culling frustum --frames 90 --warmup 30 --repeats 3 --memory scene-delta
scripts.benchmark:gpu-timing: node scripts/record-industrial-benchmark.mjs --output artifacts/benchmarks/heterogeneous-gpu-timing --scale target --profile heterogeneous --culling frustum --frames 90 --warmup 30 --repeats 3 --memory scene-delta
scripts.benchmark:gpu-timing:integrated: node scripts/record-industrial-benchmark.mjs --output artifacts/benchmarks/heterogeneous-gpu-timing-integrated --scale target --profile heterogeneous --culling frustum --frames 90 --warmup 30 --repeats 3 --memory scene-delta
